evidence.evidenceSnippet: As UQ's enterprise system, Copilot Chat provides a higher level of data security and privacy than other AI tools.
available to all UQ staff and students for no additional cost

For Microsoft 365 Copilot:


	
UQ staff may have access through UQ organisational units.
	
Students may have access through personal accounts but it is not available via UQ.
UQ organisational units can purchase and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot licences for their staff. These add-on licences have a cost per staff member.
able to access information in manually uploaded files

gaps: UQ Library acknowledgement guidance is broader than the task- and discipline-specific ITALI disclosure guidance; both scopes remain visible and course instructions must be checked.

The duration of Microsoft 365 retention and individual staff controls were not independently established. The Exchange/OneDrive example concerns staff research and does not establish a student retention configuration.
Historical age and Academic Title Holder restrictions from the older staff tool page remain unverified. Free Copilot Chat and paid Microsoft 365 Copilot are distinct.
Current thesis templates, complete HDR conditions and HRE application PDF originals were not independently obtained in this local stage.
Full staff-only procurement and case-specific data approval procedures require institutional access and remain unverified.
Reasonable-adjustment procedures do not establish blanket permission to use assistive AI in every assessment.

Ten official HTML responses and derived texts are captured and hash-bound. Twelve other source-index entries in the ChatGPT research package have no fresh raw originals in this local sample; PDF physical-page verification remains incomplete.
Historical source health failures reported for the old referencing and staff-training links remain in the research record; these links are not the basis of current displayed conclusions.
This selected evidence set does not establish complete institution-wide policy coverage; remaining research requirements and all original historical/candidate decisions are preserved.

coursework.en: UQ classifies assessment tasks as Secure or Open from Semester 2, 2026. Task instructions still specify permitted materials and tools, including any AI-use and disclosure requirements. An AI-required condition applies when students are assessed on their use of AI.

exams.en: The reviewed UQ guidance applies its Secure/Open classifications at assessment-task level. It does not establish one blanket rule for every exam; check the examination and task instructions.

disclosure.en: ITALI guidance links disclosure to relevance and task requirements; Library guidance gives broader acknowledgement advice. Keep their scopes distinct and follow the course and assessment directions.

privacy_data.en: UQ research guidance cautions against sharing sensitive or confidential research data with public AI tools. Staff Copilot Chat prompts, responses and uploaded files are retained under distinct Microsoft 365 storage and retention arrangements; the source gives no retention period.
privacy_data.zh: UQ 科研指引提醒不要将敏感或机密科研数据提供给公共 AI 工具。员工使用 Copilot Chat 时，提示、回复和上传文件分别按 Microsoft 365 存储与保留安排处理；来源未说明保留期限。

approved_tools.en: UQ provides Copilot Chat to staff and students through UQ Microsoft 365 at no additional cost. Paid Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on licences are separate. Tool availability does not decide whether a task permits AI.

research_publication.en: Researcher Hub guidance addresses disclosure, data sensitivity and use of AI services in research scenarios. The captured sources do not establish a complete rule set for every thesis, publication or research project.

academic_integrity.en: UQ describes AI outputs used without attribution and contrary to staff directions as plagiarism and academic misconduct. Its formal student misconduct procedure sets hearing, decision, penalty and appeal safeguards; it is a general procedure, not an AI-specific rule.

proposed:uq-formal-misconduct-process-20.text: For a formal UQ student misconduct proceeding, the scheduled hearing follows at least 10 business days after the allegation notice and document bundle are provided to the student. An oral hearing occurs only if requested, and a student may bring a support person. A student is not entitled to a lawyer or representative unless the Misconduct Body chair gives prior written approval. The Body will endeavour to decide within 20 business days after the notice and bundle are provided; this is an endeavour, not a fixed deadline.
